**0.7.6: Fewer capitals and full stops in the middle of sentences.**

- With insert as you go, a pause to think in the middle of a sentence no longer ends it. Each piece is now decoded together with the end of the piece before it, so the model hears the sentence carry on and keeps the case and punctuation it would use mid-sentence. On a test with pauses inside sentences, capitals mid-sentence fell from 73 to 30 and stray full stops from 27 to 10; decoding takes about a fifth longer.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
